product_summary: Per own website (shirtsinternational.com, Umbergaon, Gujarat 396171): garment manufacturing export house specialising in technical workwear and innovative textiles. Stated product lines: High Visibility Workwear (rail transport, roadworks, government/NGOs), Medical Workwear & PPE (healthcare), Corporate Uniforms, Retail Uniforms, Hospitality Uniforms, plus 'sustainable and innovative technical textiles'. Claims manufacturing and exporting to North America and Europe since 2002, more recently Australia and New Zealand. No product catalogue pages were reachable (all sub-page URLs returned 404), so the item-level breakdown (knitted vs woven, fibre composition) is not publicly verifiable.
role_hint: manufacturer (self-described garment manufacturing export house with own facility address in Umbergaon GIDC); no trader signs found on the site, but no independent corroboration of manufacturing was obtained in this pass
comment: INDUSTRY MISCLASSIFICATION: declared industry 'Продукты питания и FMCG' (food & FMCG) is wrong - the company is an apparel/technical-workwear manufacturer and exporter. Correct industry: textiles & apparel / PPE workwear. HS mapping: declared 610230 (women's anoraks etc., knitted, man-made) and 620190 (men's overcoats, other fibres, woven) are plausible for outerwear/workwear jackets but not confirmed by any product page; 620323 (men's jackets/blazers, synthetic, woven) is a poor fit - no tailored jackets/blazers are listed; 621132 (men's garments, cotton, woven - e.g. work trousers/overalls) is a reasonable fit for workwear bottoms but again unconfirmed. MISSING FROM DECLARATION: the company's core stated lines - high-visibility workwear, medical workwear/PPE (likely 621010 nonwoven or 621133/621143), corporate/hospitality/retail uniform shirts and blouses (6205/6206), and technical textiles (Chapter 59/60 fabrics) - are not represented in the declared codes. All product claims are 'заявлено, не подтверждено': no customs line, invoice or shipment record was reviewed in this pass, and the site's own catalogue sub-pages were unreachable (404), so nothing beyond the homepage text is corroborated. Per project rule 3, the HS mismatch is not a rejection ground - company is retained and codes should be corrected to the actual workwear/uniform lines above once a catalogue or invoice is obtained. Revenue, export volumes, PAN/CIN and registry data were not researched (out of scope for this role) - null.
